evidence: provider documentation and crit-labs' own source; calls, formats and GPUs are as the providers state them, not measured by crit unless a kernel says so

operations.what: the gated-delta recurrence over a prompt (chunked) and token by token (decode and a verify's columns): delta = beta (v - e^l S^T k); S' = e^l S + k delta^T; out = scale S'^T q
operations.verify: on the target, run the kernel and sequential on the same 100-200 tokens of a real layer's inputs from the same state: outputs and final state within FP32 accumulation error (relative 1e-4); for verify, the state after each column against sequential's, or the accepted prefix replayed per this entry's commit strategy

kernels.call: fla.ops.gated_delta_rule: chunk_gated_delta_rule for prompts, fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule for decode and verify (initial_state in, final state out)
formats: fp32, bf16 or fp16 inputs; fp32 state
archs: any GPU Triton supports (NVIDIA sm_80 and newer, AMD ROCm)
kernels.shapes: the head dims the release supports (64 to 256); grouped value heads
kernels.notes: returns the final state only: serves this entry's deferred (Strategy C) or recompute commit; per-column checkpoints need a scan that writes them

kernels.call: gated_delta_prefill(q, k, v, log_decay, beta, state, scale) and gated_delta_scan(..., checkpoints=...)
kernels.shapes: dk 64 or 128, dv a multiple of 64
kernels.notes: column-invariant scan with per-token checkpoints, and Mamba-2 and a causal convolution beside it; its chunked prefill measured slower than flash-linear-attention's at one model's shapes on an RTX 5090 (crit, 2026-10-28)
